text: Kubyerekeye ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa n'ingufu za gazi n'ibigendeshwa n'ibyuma bibika amashanyarazi, uburemere ntarengwa bw'ikinyabiziga hongerwaho:
Intabaza zihariye zirabagirana ku binyabiziga ndakumirwa, zigizwe n'itara rimwe cyangwa menshi amyasa y'ubururu, zigomba gukoreshwa mu gihe:

options.text: Ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa gitwaye umurwayi cyangwa abaganga
Ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kiri mu butumwa busanzwe
Ikinyabiziga ndakumirwa kiri mu butumwa bwihutirwa

text: Iyo banyuze iruhande rw'inkomyi abanyamaguru bagomba gukikira banyuze mu muhanda, abayobozi bagomba gusiga umwanya ufite ubugari bwa:
Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ugeze mu isangano ry'umuhanda ugenzurwa ni ibimenyetso by'amatara yaka agasanga ataka (adakora), yakora iki?

options.text: Guca  mu isangano n'ubwitonzi nkaho ntakimenyetso kikuyobora kirimo, witondera abandi bayobozi b'ibinyabiziga
Guhagarara mw'isangano no guha inzira abayobozi b'ibinyabiziga baturuka iburyo bwawe
Gucana amatara yose ndanga cyerekezo ugakomeza

text: Niki umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora igihe atwaye ikinyabiziga mugihe cy'ibihu,imvura nyinshi, umwuzure  cyangwa umukungugu mwinshi ?

options.text: Kugendera mu tuyira turi kumpande zu muhanda, ucunga ibimenyetso  bigarura urumuri
Kugabanya umuvuduko hanyuma ugakoresha amatara magufi
Gucana amatara  maremare  hanyuma ukagenda gahoro
Kugendera mu murongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabiri unareba ibimenyestso by'umuhanda bigarura urumuri

text: Mugihe ikinyabiziga gitanzwe, ikarita icyiranga itanzwe mbere yandikwa mw'izina ryagihawe namaze gutanga amafaranga agenwa n'iteka:

options.text: Rya minisitiri wo gutwara abantu n'ibintu

text: Hanyuranyijwe n'ibimaze kuvugwa, iteka rya minisitiri ushinzwe imirimo ya Leta rishobora gushyiraho imivuduko ntarengwa inyuranye:
Amapikipiki adafite akanyabiziga ko ku ruhande, iyo bitagishoboka kubona muri m200, agomba kugaragazwa inyuma n'amatara akurikira:
Ibimenyetso, amabara n'ubunini bw'ibyapa by'ibinyabiziga bikoreshwa n'abayobozi bakuru b'igihugu bigenwa n'iteka rya minisitiri:
Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga ugendera inyuma y'ikinyabaziga gitwara abagenzi  gihagaze gikuramo cyangwa gishyiramo abagenzi agomba :

options.text: a na b ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

text: Buri kinyamitende itatu cyangwa ine, vélo-moteri, na pikipiki, bigomba kugira ibyuma byo guhagarara, bikwiye gufunga nibura:

options.text: A na B byombi ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

text: Ibiziga by'ikinyabiziga bigendeshwa na moteri, iby'ivelo-moteri, na romoroki zikuruwe nabyo, bigomba kuba byambaye inziga:
Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga yakora iki ahuye n'ikinyabiziga  giturutse mukindi kerekezo, gicanye amatara  yumuhondo aburira ?

options.text: Umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agomba kugabanya umuvuduko no gutambukana ubwitonzi

text: Igihe umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga atwaye mu muhanda urombereje w'ibice byinshi  agomba kugendera mu kihe gice   cy'umuhanda ?

options.text: Kugendera mugice icyo aricyo cyose kirimo ibinyabiziga bike
Kugendera kugice cy'ibumoso  keretse ushaka gusohokera iburyo
Kugendera mu gice cy'iburyo bw'umuhanda keretse ushaka kunyuranaho
Ntagutwarira  mu ruhande rw'iburyo bw'umuhanda kuko hagenewe imodoka ziremereye  n'imodoka  nini zitwara abantu.

text: Kugira ngo habeho umutekano mu muhanda, umukuru w'intara ashobora, mu ifasi ashinzwe, gutegeka ko mu mihanda avuze haba:
Amatara yo kubisikana agomba kuba yera cyangwa asa umuhondo, agomba nijoro igihe ijuru rikeye kumurika muntera ya:
Ijambo inzira nyabagendwa bivuga:
Kunyuranaho bikorerwa mu ruhande:

options.text: A,B,C na D byose ni ibisubizo by'ukuri
C na D ni byo bisubizo by'ukuri

text: Umuyobozi wese w'ikinyabiziga ushaka kongera kugenda, agomba gukomeza guhagarika ikinyabiziga cye kandi akareka:

options.text: Ibinyabiziga bigiye guhura na we bigatambuka

text: Uruhusa mpuzamahanga rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rushobora guhabwa gusa abafite icyemezo cyo gutwara ibinyabiziga cyatanzwe n'igihugu cyabo kandi gifite agaciro; abagihawe batanga amafaranga:
Imodoka zo mu rwego rwa C ni imodoka zagenewe gutwara ibintu bifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe burenga:
Ushinzwe ishami ry'umutekano mu muhanda muri minisiteri ifite mushinga zayo gutwara abantu n'ibintu ni:

options.text: N'umujyanama muri komite y'igihugu ishinzwe umutekano mu muhanda
N'umunyamabanga, muri komite y'igihugu ishinzwe umutekano mu muhanda
Visi-Perezida muri komite y'igihugu ishinzwe umutekano mu muhanda

text: Gutinda gutanga ibimenyetso  ku muyobozi w'ikinyabiziga  ni gute bibangamira  abandi bakoresha umuhanda ?

options.text: bigira ingaruka gusa kubaturuka mukindi cyerekezo
bishobora gutuma batabona igihe gihagije cyo gushyira mubikorwa  icyo amenyeshejwe
baba bafite igihe gihagije cyo gushyira mu bikorwa ibyo bamyeshejwe

text: Igihe umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga agendera munzira y'icyerekezo kimwe akifuza gukata ibumoso yakora iki?

options.text: gutwara yegera umurongo wo hagati mu muhanda yerekeza ibumoso
gutwara yegera ku  uruhande rw'ibumoso bw'umuhanda
Gutwarira hafi y'umurongo ugabanya umuhanda mo kabili

text: Igihe utwaye umuntu mu kinyabiziga cyawe, akibagirwa kwambara umukandara  wo kwirinda ibyago  ugomba:

options.text: gukuramo  umukandara  wo kwirinda ibyago wambaye mukawambara mwembi
kubyerengagiza wizeyeko  nta mpanuka muri bukore
funga cyane umukandara wo kwirinda ibyago wawe
Kubibutsa kwambara umukandara wo kwirinda ibyago

text: Inziga zishobora gushyirwaho iminyururu irwanya ubunyereri, ibyo bigakorwa kugira ngo ikinyabiziga:
Bitabangamiye ububasha abagenzacyaha bahabwa n'amategeko, umugenzi wese uguweho n'impanuka agomba:

options.text: Gukora uko ashoboye kugirango uburyo bwo kugenda mu muhanda aho impanuka yabereye buhungabane
